chart.label: golden 庚 The Blade, 1995-04-29 18:00 Beijing (Overfueled; Earth 33 / Wood 33 / Metal 23 / Water 6 / Fire 5)

original.advise_catalyst: Ease is a gift right up until it dodges every hard thing. Pick one piece of what you make and finish it to done, not to pleasant. Say the awkward true sentence once a week, to the person it belongs to. Comfort that never risks anything eventually feeds no one.

repFields.function.definition_catalyst: Water is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is output that flows. Words, cooking, small kindnesses, the bright remark that turns an evening: whatever is inside you moves outward without forcing, and people are fed by it before they notice they were hungry.
repFields.function.definition_friction: Water is your Expression, and as a friction, it is output with no banks. Talent spills wherever it lands, into snacks and scrolling, into remarks that cut deeper than intended, into half-made things. Nothing is wrong, exactly. That is the problem. The spill keeps absorbing the effort your best work was waiting for.
repFields.function.advise_friction: A river with no banks is a swamp, even a pleasant one. Give your talent one container: one project, one hour, the same time every day. Let yourself be bothered on purpose by one thing that matters. And make the treat follow the work, never replace it.
repFields.mechanism.base: In the old reckoning water is metal's child: cold iron beads the morning dew, and metal, melted, runs bright as any river. The hard thing does not stay hard. At its finest edge it turns liquid, and what was fixed begins to flow, the clear stream carrying the mountain's sharpness out into the world.
repFields.mechanism.catalyst_turn: Run thin, this channel shows as pressure without release: much forged, little said. That is why your chart asks you to feed it. Writing, speaking, sharing work early lets the blade breathe.
repFields.mechanism.friction_turn: Run heavy, the flow turns to flood: output for its own sake, saying instead of shaping. The flood drinks the blade that feeds it. Cut the noise and the water clears.
repFields.cta_verdict: Your precision leaves you as flow, and the things you finally say arrive so smooth nobody sees how long you sharpened them.
repFields.carry.catalyst: This channel shows as pressure without release: much forged, little said. Writing, speaking, sharing work early lets the blade breathe.
repFields.carry.friction: The flow turns to flood: output for its own sake, saying instead of shaping. Cut the noise and the water clears.
repFields.carry.wide: There is no shortage of Water in you, the channel that lets the blade breathe. Say it while it is fresh. Ship the draft.
repFields.carry.missing: No channel out: much forged, nothing said, the pressure with nowhere to go. Borrow a channel: write it down, say it once.
repFields.carry.spared: Water runs absent, and nothing spills: the edge keeps its shape and its silence. Keep it. Speak on purpose, not on reflex.
repFields.carry.thin: Water runs thin and unwanted: a trickle of output, easy to keep clean. A trickle is enough. Keep it clean.
repFields.carry.excess: Too much water sinks the metal: output floods the work, saying everything and shaping nothing. Cut the flow. Finish one thing in silence.
